text:
SRE Bot: ALERT: p99 inference latency spike detected for hosted region-us-west-2. SLO breach: 10m window p99 > 1200ms. Paging oncall team now. :rotating_light:
Maya Patel: I'm on it. Seeing a cluster of streaming stalls in the metrics dashboard.
Alex Chen: Jumping in — any obvious downstream errors? auth/config fetch?
SRE Bot: Logs show elevated 403s and 504s from control-plane config-fetch service, auth token refresh failures, and increased DB read latency.
Priya Rao: Reproducing traces: inference path waits on config-fetch (featureflags) call before routing to model, median wait ~350ms, tail up to 1.1s. Streaming requests are timing out waiting for the flag response.
Jake Morales: Oncall Bot just sent page to Maya. @Maya can you confirm if we need to flip any routing policies?
Maya Patel: Temporary mitigation plan: 1) enable config-cache fallback on edge (fallback to last-known config) 2) route new streaming traffic to dedicated pool in eu-west-1 3) increase DB read capacity for configstore replicas. I'll run 1 now.
Ellie Kim: I'll coordinate the dedicated pool route. Alex, can you validate the model variant compatibility for cross-region?
Alex Chen: Yes, eu-west-1 has compatible variants. Rolling small % now via routing policy.
Priya Rao: Pushing config-cache-fallback toggle: ``POST /admin/featureflags/cache_fallback?env=prod`` -> response 200. Activating.
SRE Bot: SYSTEM: cache_fallback toggled by Priya Rao at 2112345702. Samples show reduced wait for follow-up requests.
Maya Patel: Observing immediate drop in config-fetch p95, but p99 still elevated likely due to auth token store rate limiting. Logs show token store 429s from auth-db.
Nirav Shah: I'm looking at the token-store metrics. There's a short burst of refresh storms from workloads that resumed after a deploy. Token-store CPU and DB connections spiked.
Jake Morales: Can we enable token-store read-through cache and add short-lived backoff?
Alex Chen: Patching token refresh logic with jittered exponential backoff may need code change — too slow for immediate. Can we set an ingress throttle on token-store from control-plane to reduce thundering?
Maya Patel: Applying ephemeral ingress rate-limit rule to token-store: ``kubectl apply -f token-store-throttle.yaml``. I'll limit to 200 rps from control-plane for 10min.
Priya Rao: Applied. Monitoring.
SRE Bot: SYSTEM: token-store ingress rule applied by Maya Patel at 2112345715.
Ellie Kim: After routing + cache fallback + token throttle we see p95 back near target, p99 dropping but still ~900ms. Streaming stalls count down ~70% from peak. Customer impact: several enterprise customers reported intermittent audio->text streaming gaps in last 12 mins.
Maya Patel: Noting impacted customers and scale: 3 enterprise workspaces, approx 150k tokens/min at peak. Escalating to CS for proactive outreach.
Priya Rao: We also have featureflag service pods OOM-ing in one AZ. I recommend a quick pod restart and increasing memory limit before full rollout.
Alex Chen: Rolling restart on featureflag deployment in us-west-2 now with 30s grace: ``kubectl rollout restart deployment/featureflag -n controlplane``
Nirav Shah: Restart completed, pods are back up. Memory usage remains high — will open a ticket to bump limit in next deploy. For now restarts reduced error rate.
Jake Morales: Observability note: add a synthetic streaming test to detect config-fetch-induced stalls earlier. File follow-up item.
Maya Patel: Oncall status: I will hand off the incident to Ellie in 15min for mitigation monitoring. Ellie, take it at 2112345730 — I'll document actions in ops.
Ellie Kim: Ack. I'll continue monitoring p99 and customer impacts. Currently p99 ~620ms and trending down.
Oncall Bot: HANDOFF: Oncall handover initiated by Maya Patel -> Ellie Kim. Pager duty notes included.
Priya Rao: CS notified customers A/B/C with preliminary notice. No data exfiltration, only latency and stalls.
Alex Chen: Post-mortem action items (short list): 1) implement token-store client backoff 2) permanent config-cache fallback with TTL 3) increase featureflag memory and add probe to avoid OOM restart loops 4) synthetic tests for config-fetch streaming impact.
Ellie Kim: Logging final: current state stable, p99 below SLO threshold for last 4 mins. Keeping incident thread open for 1h for regression watch.
SRE Bot: INCIDENT: mitigations applied, partial rollback not needed. Incident state: monitoring.
Maya Patel: Thanks team — good run. I'll open the incident ticket and assign action items. :thumbsup:
Ellie Kim: I'll take postmortem and timeline. Leaving notes here and will add detailed traces and Grafana links in the ticket.
SRE Bot: NOTE: thread archived in incident tracker with id INC-2026-392.
